narrative.details:
Greetings, champion. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the Horde's efforts at gathering wool bandages. Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. Trust me, I know first hand. Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.

If you have the time, I need many wool bandages. Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Wool Bandages to Healer Longrunner at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
narrative.requestItemsText: The dredge strikers are a serious threat and must be dealt with quickly!
